title: At Pune's Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research

sections.heading: Eduskill
sections.content:
Single Point of Contact: Prof. Rama Gaikwad (Head, Computer Engineering),
Email: rama.gaikwad@abmspcoerpune.org
The Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between Eduskills and Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering and Research aims to enhance the educational landscape by fostering skill development and promoting innovative learning methodologies. This collaboration focuses on equipping students with industry-relevant skills through specialized training programs, workshops, and internships. By leveraging Eduskills’ expertise in educational technology and APCOER’s commitment to academic excellence, the partnership seeks to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, empowering students to excel in their chosen fields and contribute effectively to the workforce.
